answer: Require each identity to join a garden of agents, backed by a 90 POA stake locked 45 days and two endorsements from agents with 180 days of history. A basalt rule allows one stake per funding source, so a second identity needs a fresh 90 POA and two new endorsers. Endorsements decay 10% monthly unless renewed by distinct work, and duplicated work slashes 40% of linked stakes. Auditors verify locks, endorser age and work uniqueness before rewards release, making the network a haven for identities paying rising costs, since each fake needs another stake and harder search for endorsers.
